name: comp-157
title: Star Rating Filter Radio
description: A vertical radio list of review ratings, from all reviews down to one star, each row showing amber stars, dimmed empty stars and a count. Choosing a row keeps that rating selected.
use: Narrowing a review or listing to one star level, with the count for each level beside it.
avoid: Copy, counts and the six rows are fixed inside the file, so a new rating level needs a source edit.
a11y: Native radio inputs give arrow-key navigation, and star rows carry hidden text labels. Counts are part of the label, so long totals are read out too. (keyboard: yes, labels: good, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: Six rows on a near-black panel: a round radio outline on the left, a small gap, then white text. The top row reads All reviews with a grey count; the other five hold five small amber stars, the unused ones faded, then a grey count.
behaves: Hovering a row draws a soft ring around its radio circle. Clicking a row moves the white dot there: the demo opens with All reviews chosen and ends on five stars.
customise: Labels, counts and stars are written in the file; change them by editing it. Add or remove rows by copying a row block. Accent colour is one amber utility class.
weight: light: Six static rows of icon SVGs and native radio inputs; nothing runs after mount.
